nullable=False)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Program(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"programs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    code = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Application(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    applicant_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Draft\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('Draft','Submitted','Under Review','Waitlist Review','Accepted','Rejected','Withdrawn')\")\n    submitted_at = Column(DateTime)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass RecommendationRequirement(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"recommendation_requirements\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    requirement_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"requirement_type IN ('Science Faculty','Clinical Supervisor','Other')\")\n    required_count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1, check_constraint=\"required_count > 0\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        UniqueConstraint('program_id', 'requirement_type'),\n    )\n\nclass RecommendationRequest(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"recommendation_requests\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applications.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    requirement_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"recommendation_requirements.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    recommender_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    recommender_email = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    recommender_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"recommender_type IN ('Science Faculty','Clinical Supervisor','Other')\")\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Pending\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('Pending','Submitted','Incomplete','Expired')\")\n    requested_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    submitted_at = Column(DateTime)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass DeadlineRule(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"deadline_rules\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    rule_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    deadline_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"deadline_type IN ('Recommendation Submission','Final Application','Other')\")\n    deadline_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    action_on_missing = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"action_on_missing IN ('Waitlist Review','Reject','Notify')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass ReminderSchedule(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"reminder_schedules\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    reminder_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"reminder_type IN ('Recommendation Incomplete','Application Incomplete','Other')\")\n    interval_days = Column(Integer, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"interval_days > 0\")\n    start_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    end_date = Column(DateTime)\n    is_active = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1, check_constraint=\"is_active IN (0,1)\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass ReminderLog(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"reminder_logs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    reminder_schedule_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"reminder_schedules.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applications.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    sent_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Sent\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('Sent','Failed','Skipped')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)"

reminder_type: str\n    interval_days: int\n    start_date: datetime\n    end_date: Optional[datetime] = None\n    is_active: bool\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n       "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import DeadlineRule\nfrom schemas import DeadlineRuleIn, DeadlineRuleOut, DeadlineRuleListResponse, DeleteResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api\",\n    tags=[\"DeadlineRules\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/programs/{program_id}/deadline-rules\", response_model=DeadlineRuleOut, operation_id=\"create_program_deadline_rule\")\nasync def create_program_deadline_rule(program_id: int, rule: DeadlineRuleIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_rule = DeadlineRule(\n        program_id=program_id,\n        rule_name=rule.rule_name,\n        deadline_type=rule.deadline_type,\n        deadline_date=rule.deadline_date,\n        action_on_missing=rule.action_on_missing\n    )\n    db.add(db_rule)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_rule)\n    return db_rule\n\n\n@router.get(\"/programs/{program_id}/deadline-rules\", response_model=DeadlineRuleListResponse, operation_id=\"list_program_deadline_rules\")\nasync def list_program_deadline_rules(program_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    deadline_rules = db.query(DeadlineRule).filter(DeadlineRule.program_id == program_id).order_by(DeadlineRule.deadline_date).all()\n    return {\"deadline_rules\": deadline_rules}\n\n\n@router.put(\"/deadline-rules/{rule_id}\", response_model=DeadlineRuleOut, operation_id=\"update_deadline_rule\")\nasync def update_deadline_rule(rule_id: int, rule: DeadlineRuleIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_rule = db.query(DeadlineRule).filter(DeadlineRule.id == rule_id).first()\n    if not db_rule:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Deadline rule not found\")\n\n    for key, value in rule.dict(exclude_unset=True).items():\n        setattr(db_rule, key, value)\n\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_rule)\n    return db_rule\n\n\n@router.delete(\"/deadline-rules/{rule_id}\", response_model=DeleteResponse, operation_id=\"delete_deadline_rule\")\nasync def delete_deadline_rule(rule_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_rule = db.query(DeadlineRule).filter(DeadlineRule.id == rule_id).first()\n    if not db_rule:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Deadline rule not found\")\n\n    db.delete(db_rule)\n    db.commit()\n    return {\"message\": \"Deadline rule deleted successfully\"}"

import ReminderScheduleIn, ReminderScheduleOut, ReminderScheduleListResponse, DeleteResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api\",\n    tags=[\"ReminderSchedules\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/programs/{program_id}/reminder-schedules\", response_model=ReminderScheduleOut, operation_id=\"create_reminder_schedule\")\nasync def create_reminder_schedule(program_id: int, schedule: ReminderScheduleIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_schedule = ReminderSchedule(\n        program_id=program_id,\n        reminder_type=schedule.reminder_type,\n        interval_days=schedule.interval_days,\n        start_date=schedule.start_date,\n        end_date=schedule.end_date,\n        is_active=int(schedule.is_active)\n    )\n    db.add(db_schedule)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_schedule)\n    return db_schedule\n\n\n@router.put(\"/programs/{program_id}/reminder-schedules/{schedule_id}\", response_model=ReminderScheduleOut, operation_id=\"update_reminder_schedule\")\nasync def update_reminder_schedule(program_id: int, schedule_id: int, schedule: ReminderScheduleIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_schedule = db.query(ReminderSchedule).filter(ReminderSchedule.id == schedule_id).first()\n    if not db_schedule:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Reminder schedule not found\")\n\n    for key, value in schedule.dict(exclude_unset=True).items():\n        if key == \"is_active\":\n            setattr(db_schedule, key, int(value))\n        else:\n            setattr(db_schedule, key, value)\n\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_schedule)\n    return db_schedule\n\n\n@router.delete(\"/programs/{program_id}/reminder-schedules/{schedule_id}\", response_model=DeleteResponse, operation_id=\"delete_reminder_schedule\")\nasync def delete_reminder_schedule(program_id: int, schedule_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    db_schedule = db.query(ReminderSchedule).filter(ReminderSchedule.id == schedule_id).first()\n    if not db_schedule:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Reminder schedule not found\")\n\n    db.delete(db_schedule)\n    db.commit()\n    return {\"message\": \"Reminder schedule deleted successfully\"}"
